decisive_items: Brain Biopsy (left frontal lesion): CD5− CD10− CD19+ CD20+ BCL6+ MUM-1+ EBV/EBER−
Cerebrospinal fluid: Presence of lymphoma cells
T1-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI with contrast showed absence of contrast enhancement
response.rationale: The biopsy immunophenotype (CD19+, CD20+, BCL6+, MUM-1+) and CSF lymphoma cells are diagnostic of primary CNS lymphoma. The non-enhancing pattern is atypical but does not override the definitive pathology.

rejected.why: MRI findings are nonspecific, but the presence of lymphoma cells and B-cell markers on biopsy rule out multiple sclerosis.
Lack of contrast enhancement and the biopsy results (B-cell markers) are inconsistent with glioblastoma.
